title: Paper

questions.question: Have you made any crafts with paper?
questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, I have. I remember making paper boats and simple origami when I was a child. It was when I was about seven, and I felt really proud of each little thing I made.

questions.question: Do you still write physical letters?
questions.sampleAnswer: Actually, I don’t really write physical letters anymore. I used to, but now I just send messages or emails, because they’re instant and free.

questions.question: Do people still keep handwritten letters today?
questions.sampleAnswer: I’d say nowadays fewer people keep handwritten letters, because most messages are digital. But some people still treasure old letters as memories, and young people sometimes write them for special occasions. So it’s rare but not gone.

questions.question: Do you carry paper and pens with you when you go out?
questions.sampleAnswer: Not usually, to be honest. I tend to rely on my phone for notes and reminders, so I rarely carry paper and pens, unless I’m going to a class where I need them.

questions.question: What did you like to do with paper as a child?
questions.sampleAnswer: I can still remember I loved drawing and cutting paper into shapes. I used to fold paper airplanes and race them with my friends, which was one of my favourite pastimes.
